Q1. Which part of this repository should be changed?
Choices:
A. One specific workflow, script, or file path - name the exact path(s) (RECOMMENDED)
B. Clarify / plan / implement phase behavior - name the affected workflow or script if known
C. Review/autofix / conflict-resolution behavior - name the affected workflow or script if known
D. Orchestrator / validate / memory / other automation behavior - name the affected workflow or script if known
Q2. What should "better" mean for that area?
Choices:
A. A concrete behavior fix - describe the current behavior, the expected behavior, and one example/log (RECOMMENDED)
B. A new or changed workflow behavior - describe the trigger, inputs, and expected output
C. A docs/comment/message update only - name the exact file/text and the desired change
D. A performance/cost/noise improvement - state the measurable problem and the target improvement
